method: Each sample runs a fresh Node process. For decode-only measurements the harness runs the compiled public parser, wraps the core parse call with a timer, and derives preflight from total parse time minus core time. Probe overhead is included. Serialization and process startup are outside the phase timings. Peak RSS includes serialization and is not directly comparable between retained and unretained output. Without retention is an experimental control on the same binary. Reverse trials list the trial driver first.
